full_judgment: 31. Mr Ahmed further submitted that the petitioner then preferred case before the administrative Tribunal being AT Case No. 169 of 1999 on 24-8-1999 in the Administrative Tribunal No. 1, Dhaka, which was dismissed on 26-6-2001 being without jurisdiction and barred by limitation (Annexure-M). Then the petitioner preferred AAT Appeal No. 103 of 2001 and by judgment and order dated 12-6-2008 and the Appeal was dismissed holding that the AT Case No. 169 of 1999 was filed beyond limitation (annexure- M-1).
